meta.description: Conversacion multi-modelo con participantes, alias, turnos y manager de grupo. Parches locales: persistencia por chat, popup sin modelos preseleccionados, foco en moderador, fallback no-streaming, prioridad de @chips, limpieza de historial y reinicio de fases por solicitud.

manifest.title: Multi Model Conversations v2
manifest.author: Haervwe
manifest.local_patch: Changed _check_model_native_fc to async and awaited the call.
manifest.local_patch_models_dropdown: Passes available models from backend app.state.MODELS into the configuration popup and keeps browser fetch as optional refresh.
manifest.local_patch_state_config: Avoids AttributeError when Open WebUI app.state has no config attribute.
manifest.local_patch_chat_meta_persistence: Persists multi_model_config in chat.meta and reloads it on later messages.
manifest.local_patch_moderator_focus: Prompts participants to prioritize David/moderator and avoid side conversations unless requested.
manifest.local_patch_defaults: Popup starts with empty participant model fields, 2 participant slots, and one round; existing chats reload their persisted participants.
manifest.local_patch_streaming_fallback: Suppresses unsupported-streaming errors and lets non-stream fallback answer.
manifest.local_patch_default_before_popup: Uses valid UserValves/default participants before opening configuration popup.
manifest.local_patch_selected_model_priority: selected_model from Open WebUI @ chips always routes to a one-model turn.
manifest.local_patch_clean_model_history: Removes UI details/summary/tool-warning markup before feeding history to participant models.
manifest.local_patch_one_more_round: Interprets 'una ronda mas' as one group cycle, not two cycles.
manifest.local_patch_brainstorm_debate_rounds: Parses 'N rondas de lluvia de ideas con debate' as N debate rounds before vote/conclusion.
manifest.local_patch_vote_scope_current_request: Counts conclusion votes only from the current request, avoiding stale winners from prior problems.
